headline: Meta Opens Muse AI Framework for Broad Consumer Integration
summary: Meta has released the Muse AI framework, allowing developers to integrate advanced AI capabilities into consumer devices. This move is expected to accelerate the adoption of AI in everyday products, driving innovation and competition in the consumer tech sector.
whyItMatters: It opens up new opportunities for integrating sophisticated AI into consumer electronics, potentially transforming the way people interact with technology in their daily lives.
